name: retriever
description: Retriever - Web Harvester & Tech Scraper Suite powered by HTTrack & Modern Markdown Extraction

scripts.desktop:build: tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist-electron/desktop/renderer | Out-Null; Set-Content dist-electron/package.json '{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}'; Copy-Item desktop/renderer/index.html dist-electron/desktop/renderer/index.html -Force; Copy-Item desktop/renderer/index.css dist-electron/desktop/renderer/index.css -Force"
